svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Atlas Map view (⌥1) as a 3D globe, Landscape L0 (INC-2041)
svg.desc: The Map view at ladder level L0 drawn as a 3D globe of the real Earth, seen from above the North Atlantic (camera over 38° N, 30° W) with Europe, Africa and the Americas on the front. The deep ocean is a dark navy sphere with a faint specular highlight; land is drawn from built-in country outlines in a muted natural relief (olive lowlands, sand deserts, darker forests, pale polar ice, soft shaded mountain ridges) with hairline coastlines, very faint borders, a sparse dot-matrix texture and faint cloud wisps. The night side is dimmed by a soft terminator for 12:31 UTC in November, with sparse warm city lights over western North America and the Arctic; a blue atmosphere glow rims the limb. Each region or data centre stands where it really is as a district of extruded hexagons whose height encodes load, neutral grey when healthy: us-east-1 in northern Virginia is Watch (yellow), us-west-2 in Oregon sits on the night side, sa-east-1 near São Paulo and FRA-DC1 in Frankfurt are OK, and LON-DC2 in London is a hatched stale ghost. eu-west-1 in Dublin glows Failing with a magenta ⊕ origin beacon rising radially (payments → psp-api, INC-2041). The external psp-api sits above Amsterdam as an orange ring marker (outside the estate); a lifted red great-circle arc with particles carries the failing calls to it (38% failing). Neutral blue-grey arcs carry replication to us-east-1 and traffic to FRA-DC1. Unplaced external dependencies ride a dashed outside-the-estate orbit ring; a chip pinned at the right limb lists three sites on the far side. A docked 2D strip shows eu-west-1 error rate over the last hour, linked to the selection, with the −7d ghost, the ⚙ 12:19 timeout change and ⚠ 12:22 onset. HUD: top bar, view switcher with Map active, layer chips with Health active, Orbit · Map · Fly chip, altitude ladder with L0 lit, altitude readout with a dive hint, a real equirectangular minimap with the visible hemisphere outlined, orbit gizmo, care queue and the Time Ribbon.

g.text: Blast radius: 3 regions see checkout errors
on-prem · 122 hosts blind · collector down 6 min
search p99 1.1 s · owner on it
Origin is a beacon off the surface
⊕ rises radially from eu-west-1, so it
reads from any orbit; glow = anomaly.
Each site is an extruded hex district
at its real place; colour only where
psp-api is a ring at its real city
city lights mark the night side.
Far-side trouble pins to the limb.
Land, relief and coastlines are built
